items.title: Induction compatibility of Ihara L-functions for finite abelian group actions on graphs with vertex stabilizers
items.author: Rusiru Gambheera; Daniel Vallieres
items.difficulty_reason: The counted object is the full induced-representation compatibility construction for Ihara L-functions in the presence of vertex stabilizers, not the short final reduction alone. It requires equivariant graph chain modules, group-ring Euler and determinant factors, norm/induction compatibility and their Artin-representation realizations. Full source-local supporting constructions and proofs are retained. Old183011 only gives Euler-characteristic transfer1090–1131, one factor in the framework; the determinant/norm and L-function induction arguments are additional content. Original finite abelian group/no-inversion scope retained, and author failure of unrestricted inflation remains explicit. General matrix preliminaries, applications and examples are not separate counts.

primary.label: Complete original induction compatibility for both factors and Ihara L-function
